cf_titulo_laudo: Data for the Forensic Examination Report
cf_grupo_id: 1. Case and device (from the record, read only)
cf_ph_objetivo: What was requested: purpose of the examination and questions, if any.
cf_aviso_modalidade_sugerido: Filled in with the modules this acquisition recorded running. Can be rewritten.
cf_aviso_modalidade_vazio: The method of this acquisition could not be read, and nothing was suggested here. Describe the method used.
cf_aviso_protocolos: Items that depend on who performed the examination. The remaining requirements of the standard are verified by the tool itself and appear in the document with the record that proves them.
cf_ph_consideracoes: Optional. Goes into the conclusion, identified as the examiner's considerations.
cf_nota_consideracoes: The report's conclusion is derived from the outcome recorded in the acquisition. The text below is appended to it, as your statement.
cf_rotulo_fotos:
Photographs: {fotos}
The SHA-256 of this acquisition's manifest is computed and printed in the document automatically.
fha_nota_pdf: Quick read: opens with what the collection obtained. A field marked NOT DETERMINED does not mean the data is absent from the device — it means the collection, within its limitations, did not reach it. Each value can be checked in the sealed acquisition, at the path indicated as its source.
fha_sub_txt: Quick read — opens with what was obtained
fha_rodape_txt: NOT DETERMINED does not mean the data is absent from the device: it means the collection, within its limitations, did not reach it. The raw, sealed material of each field is in the acquisition, at the path indicated under 'source'.
re_sec_14: 14. Standard requirements verified by the tool
re_conteudo_erro: The content of this acquisition could NOT be interpreted for this report ({erro}). The raw material remains in the acquisition; nothing is asserted here about what it contains.
bl_operador_nao_registrado: Not recorded in this acquisition (prior to operator recording)
bl_id_sem_cadeia: This acquisition has no chain-of-custody record (cadeia_custodia.txt). The case and item data could not be read.
bl_id_nao_declarado: The operator is recorded as {valor}: the examiner's profile was not filled in at the time of the acquisition. The system account above was obtained by the tool and is not equivalent to identifying a person.
bl_id_teste: Acquisition made by the test account (Forensic Admin) of the development build of the suite: it is a TEST, with no forensic value, and this is recorded under the acquisition seal.
bl_id_auth_senha: The operator is the examiner whose password opened the session on this station; their data is that of the registration. The password does not prove identity, and the tool does not verify it beyond that. The system account was obtained by the tool.
bl_id_declarado: The operator is the one DECLARED in the examiner's profile; the tool does not verify identity. The system account was obtained by the tool.
bl_sem_caracteristicas: No characteristic was obtained from the device itself in this acquisition — the modules that read them were not run. This is not absence of the characteristic on the device: it is absence of collection.
bl_peca_declarado: Declared in the record (chain of custody)
bl_peca_apurado: Obtained by the extraction, from the device itself
bl_peca_nota: These are the values the device's system declares about itself. On a device with a modified system, they may not correspond to the real equipment. The separation between what is declared and what is obtained is deliberate: the tool supports the latter with a record; the former depends on who filled it in.
bl_fotos_nenhuma: No photograph of the item was attached to this acquisition.
bl_ambiente_nota: Environment recorded at the time of the acquisition, in the procedure record — not that of the station on which this document was printed. It is what lets a third party reproduce the conditions of the examination (repeatability and reproducibility, ISO/IEC 27037).
bl_ambiente_sem: The station environment is not in the procedure record of this acquisition.
bl_ambiente_sem_relogio: There is no clock measurement recorded in this acquisition. The dates of the device's records could not be compared against the station clock.
bl_auth_nenhuma: No authorization document was attached to the case at the time of this acquisition. This does NOT assert that the authorization does not exist: it means only that the tool had no document in view to copy and hash.
bl_auth_nota: The tool asserts only that these files, with these hashes, were attached to the case at the time of the acquisition. It does not read the content of the documents: it does not attest authenticity, signature or validity.
bl_metodo_vazio: The method record of this acquisition was not found. The modules used could not be reproduced here from what was sealed.
bl_lim_vazio: The method record was not found, and the limitations declared on the day of the examination could not be reproduced.
bl_lim_sem: The modules used declared no limitations.
bl_lim_intro: The limitations below are those of the method, not of this device in particular. They are stated so that the absence of a datum in the collected material is not interpreted as the absence of the datum on the examined device.
bl_lim_alteracoes_titulo: Changes the collection could cause on the device
bl_alt_vazio: No change to the device was noted in the procedure record.
bl_dec_vazio: No methodological decision was noted in the procedure record.
bl_tempo_vazio: The procedure record of this acquisition was not found or has no entries.
bl_desfecho_vazio: The outcome record of this acquisition was not found. It is not possible to reproduce here, from what was sealed, what each module obtained.
bl_desfecho_nota: 'Completed with caveat' is not equivalent to 'Completed': the module obtained part of the material and declared what it did not reach. 'No data obtained' means that material was not acquired — not that it does not exist on the device.
bl_conteudo_nao_interpretado: The content of this acquisition was not interpreted for this document.
bl_art_nao_coletado: NOT COLLECTED — the corresponding module was not run or did not obtain the material. It is not absence of data on the device.
bl_conteudo_nota: Dates converted to {fuso}. The content is an interpretation of the raw material, which remains untouched under the seal; the record-by-record detail is in the Content Report. A fragment not interpreted means the document is incomplete relative to the evidence at that point.
bl_analise_nenhum: No communication artifact with records was interpreted in this acquisition.
bl_integ_sem_manifesto: This acquisition has no integrity manifest. Nothing can be asserted here about the preservation of the material: the absence of the seal prevents verification.
bl_integ_sem_conf: no verification after the collection was recorded — this does not indicate a problem, it indicates that verification has not yet been run
bl_integ_nota: The manifest records the individual hash of each acquired file, computed at the close of the acquisition. The value above is the hash of the manifest itself: altering any file, or the seal itself, changes this number. It also appears in the footer of every page of this document.
bl_integ_ausentes: ATTENTION: {n} file(s) listed in the manifest were not found on disk at the time this document was issued. Run the integrity verification.
bl_inv_sem: Without a manifest, the material could not be inventoried.
bl_cat_sem: Without a manifest, the acquired files could not be listed.
bl_cat_nenhum: No file was acquired beyond the records of the acquisition itself.
bl_cat_nota: The category comes from the file name EXTENSION, not from analysis of the content: zero in a category means no acquired file has that extension, not that no content of that type exists. The files remain where they were acquired, under the seal, at the path below. The records of the acquisition itself (procedure, method, outcome, photos of the item) are not included here. Command outputs recorded by the modules appear as text.
bl_cat_primeiros: The first {limite} are listed, in alphabetical path order, of {total}. The complete list, with each file's hash, is in {manifesto}.
bl_man_sem: There is no manifest to reproduce.
bl_man_limite: The manifest covers {n} files. The first {limite} are reproduced below, in alphabetical path order; the complete list is in {manifesto}, in the acquisition folder, and it — not this reproduction — is what the footer hash seals.
bl_prot_f_intro: Requirements of ISO/IEC 27037:2013 that the tool itself proves, each with the record that supports the answer.
bl_prot_e_vazio: The protocols that depend on the examiner were not answered for this document.
bl_prot_e_intro: Circumstances of the examination that only the person who performed it observed. They are statements of fact, not an assessment of conformity: 'No' does not indicate an irregularity.
ld_titulo_doc_sem_extracao: Forensic Examination Report — Examination without extraction
ld_preambulo_nota_base: The acquisition operator is the one recorded, under seal, on the day of collection. The examiner who signs is the one who issues this report.
ld_preambulo_nota_senha: Both opened the session with their own password on this workstation; the password does not prove identity, and the tool does not verify it beyond that.
ld_preambulo_nota_declarado: Both data are declared; the tool does not verify identity.
ld_sem_objetivo: The examiner did not state the purpose of the examination or any questions.
ld_metodo_intro: The acquisition followed the guidelines of ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 27037:2013 (identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of digital evidence). The hash of each file was computed at the close of the acquisition, and every command output was preserved as part of the material.
ld_conteudo_erro: The content of this acquisition could NOT be interpreted for this report ({erro}). Nothing is asserted here about what the material contains.
ld_conc_vazio: It was not possible to reproduce the outcome of this collection from what was sealed in the acquisition. This report asserts neither completeness nor incompleteness of the material: the record needed to do so is not available.
ld_conc_integral: {resumo} All modules used concluded without reservation, and the acquired material is preserved under the integrity seal described in section 7. The limitations of the method are listed in section 5 and delimit what this collection reaches.
ld_conc_cancelada: Execution was interrupted before going through all the planned modules, so the acquired material is PARTIAL in relation to what had been planned.
ld_conc_falharam: There was a module that obtained no data. The absence of the corresponding material results from this, and does NOT authorize concluding that the data does not exist on the device.
ld_conc_ressalva: There was a module concluded with reservation, that is, which obtained part of the material and declared what it did not reach. Section 6 identifies which.
ld_conc_final: The material actually acquired is preserved under the seal described in section 7, and the limitations of the method are listed in section 5.
ld_encerramento: This report is accompanied by the Extraction Report of the same acquisition, which carries the procedure timeline and the reproduction of the hash manifest. The page numbering and the manifest hash appear in the footer.
ld_se_sem_caracteristicas: No characteristic was read from the device itself: there was no extraction, and the connection attempt (section 5) obtained no identification from it. The description of the item is the one declared above, in the registration.

cc_capa:
Content dossier

Acquisition: {nome}
Dossier issued on: {{emitido}}

This dossier presents what was normalized from the acquisition, in blocks ready to copy. It does not replace the spreadsheets: the .csv files alongside are the data to cross-reference, filter and work the investigation.

Copy block takes the segment to the text editor with the full tables. Generate PDF of this block opens the print of that block only.

At the print destination, choose “Save as PDF”, from the browser itself — not “Microsoft Print to PDF”. The Windows printer turns each letter into a drawing: the PDF comes out with no text and cannot be searched.

Each block ends with the source acquisition, the manifest SHA-256 and the normalizer version. Keep that line when pasting.

This document PRESENTS the evidence; it does not replace it. Each line
  of the spreadsheets carries the source file and line, and the original
  remains in the sealed acquisition, where it can be checked.

  To normalize is to interpret: dates were converted from the device
  format to the time zone declared above, and numeric codes were
  translated. An unrecognized code is presented as such, never
  guessed.

  A count of zero NEVER means, by itself, an absence of data on the
  device. The reason for each zero is stated above.
